a source that keeps losing its 64-slot cache position keeps scanning (before, every such search rebuilt the index)
the retained lanes, invariant 6 (no second spelling store) and the retained-bytes bound are unchanged: an entry without blocks retains only the weak owner key, the coordinate and the length
